rules.description: panote-json-edge-cache: slug pointers and pub bundles follow the origin max-age; 404 is never stored
panote-tiles-404-no-store: a tile 404 is never stored at the edge; changes only the 404 TTL, not what is cacheable, so manifest.json stays DYNAMIC
rules.expression: (http.host eq "cdn.panote.io" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/tiles/") and not ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/manifest.json"))
